_comment: 20 facts and 20 questions used only by tests/memory/recall-corpus.test.ts (docs/memory.md Phase 4). The test must pass under FTS-only search, because that is what CI runs.

facts.body: the package manager is pnpm, never npm
the build runs TypeScript directly with node --experimental-strip-types, there is no compile step
the SQLite handle is opened once, by the memory server; the agent process must never open it
the web dev server listens on port 5173 through Vite
the memory MCP server runs on port 8790 and authenticates with a bearer token
conversations are stored as JSONL under .flypi/sessions, one file per session
the browser talks to the server over a WebSocket at /ws and resumes with lastSeq
prompt cache reuse needs a stable request prefix, so never put a timestamp in the system prompt
tests run with vitest and the coverage thresholds live in vitest.config.ts
the scheduler re-claims a running job once its lease has expired
the embedding model is Xenova/gte-small with 384 dimensions, loaded through @huggingface/transformers
embeddings are disabled in CI, search falls back to FTS-only BM25 and marks its results partial
the write gate rejects a duplicate body and any cosine above 0.9 to an active row
a contradiction check is one classifier pass over at most five candidates and never recurses
the wiki is generated into .flypi/wiki and the database stays the source of truth
the daemon writes its pid and port to .flypi/daemon.json
encrypted secrets live in .flypi/secrets with an AES-256-GCM key file
the plan tab shows the agent's own todo tool state, it never keeps a second task list
a reconnecting browser is replayed from a ring buffer of 2000 events per conversation
an attachment reaches the model as an image only when the model's input list includes image

questions.ask: which package manager does this project use
how is TypeScript run without a compile step
may the agent process open the SQLite handle as well
what port does the web dev server listen on
which port does the memory MCP server use and how does it authenticate
where are conversations kept on disk
what transport does the browser use to talk to the server
why must the system prompt stay byte-identical between calls
what runs the tests and where are coverage thresholds configured
what happens to a running job when the daemon that started it dies
which embedding model is used and how many dimensions
how does search behave in CI where embeddings are disabled
what stops the store from saving the same fact twice
how many classifier passes may a contradiction check make
is the generated wiki the source of truth
where does the daemon record its pid and port
where are the encrypted secrets kept
does the plan tab keep its own task list
how many past events can a reconnecting browser be replayed
when is an attachment sent to the model as an image
